# Operational ownership

Builder: schemas, canonical domain, storage, protocols and integrated behavior. Independent Auditor: architecture reports/probes, not substantive certified fixes. Independent Tester: acceptance expectations/execution, not feature implementation. Licensing Steward: locks/notices/artifact status. GitHub Steward: .github, history, refs, remotes and qualifying merges. Director: scope/contracts/decision ledger, no main merge or acceptance waiver.

Only one primary writer per shared architecture area. Feature branches/worktrees isolate implementation. A single human GitHub account does not provide independent review identities; authored reports and exact-commit gated Steward execution provide the owner-approved interim independent checks.
